cover_letter.greeting: Dear Nucleus Advisors Client Portfolios Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, Data Management & Reporting role at Nucleus Advisors. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in this role because accurate reporting on alternative investments is what clients rely on, and it's a good way to learn asset allocation and private markets from the inside.

Most of my work has been keeping numbers reliable and easy to read. At Thomson Reuters I handled cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows and ran reconciliation that reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At JPMorgan Asset Management I turned large datasets into executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership on marketing-channel budget allocation. At Lenovo I owned the mapping and QA on reporting automation that saved 4+ hours a week, so I know where a reporting process tends to break.

That maps to the monthly and quarterly client reports, data quality checks and process documentation on your team. Working with fund managers and administrators would be new for me, and I'd want to learn it quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, Data Management & Reporting role at Nucleus Advisors. At Thomson Reuters I ran reconciliation and cash flow analysis, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I built executive reporting and dashboards. I'd love to hear how the Client Portfolios team works. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
